answer: Each Ember‑agent earns an umber‑colored reputation token that accrues only while it logs verifiable timber‑sourced tasks, timestamped on a public horizon ledger. The token’s weight grows with activity and decays when idle, so a new identity starts at zero and must lock time‑locked work to gain voting power. An attacker must spin many agents and sustain costly compute‑heavy streams for weeks, making the sybil cost grow linearly with count.
